lede: One security story surfaced in three feeds at once: a PHP vulnerability drew 238,212 Wikipedia views under the name PHP2Shell, reached 322 points on Hacker News beneath a thread arguing there isn't an easy exploit for it, and drew a Mastodon post remarking that 70 percent of the internet needs fixing. Wikipedia's most-read page was quieter and stranger, with Jailer 2 pulling 278,796 views and no clear reason attached. Over on Steam, Counter-Strike 2 held a 1,205,009 concurrent-player peak across the day.

throughlines.title: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
throughlines.gist: ComfyUI, the open source node based workspace for building generative image and video pipelines, showed up on GitHub's trending repos and Hugging Face at the same time.

throughlines.title: mitmproxy adds --emudhra option
throughlines.gist: A change to mitmproxy, the interactive HTTPS proxy developers use to inspect encrypted traffic, drew attention on both Hacker News and Mastodon.

throughlines.title: Call of Duty®
throughlines.gist: Call of Duty was pulling an audience on both Steam's charts and YouTube's trending videos on the same day.
